Indian Companies File for IPOs Amid Global Private Equity Interest

Several Indian companies, including Pristine Logistics and Fibe, have filed for initial public offerings (IPOs) as global private equity firms show interest in the country's infrastructure sector. The government has allocated a record ₹12.2 trillion for capital expenditure, drawing attention from foreign investors. Meanwhile, domestic companies are also exploring IPO options to raise funds.
